Title: Create a new order successfully with customer gender and item details
Preconditions: A registered shop exists in the system and valid item definitions are configured.
Steps:
1. Submit a request to create a new order with valid customer name, customer phone, customer gender, delivery date, and order items.
2. Verify the server response status and message.
3. Retrieve the created order details using the generated order ID.

Test Data: Customer Name: "Alice Smith", Customer Phone: "01711223344", Customer Gender: "FEMALE", Delivery Date: "2026-04-30", Paid Amount: 500, Items: [Item ID: 1, Making Charge: 300]
Expected Result: The order is created successfully with HTTP status 200, returning a generated order ID and summary containing total amount, paid amount, due amount, and customer details.

Title: Access API documentation specification via updated endpoint path
Steps:
1. Send an HTTP GET request to access the OpenAPI documentation endpoint at '/v3/api-docs'.
2. Inspect the response status and the returned OpenAPI specification schema.

Test Data: Endpoint URL: '/v3/api-docs'
Expected Result: The API documentation is returned successfully with HTTP 200 OK, containing server configuration set to 'http://localhost:8083' with description 'Local server'.

Title: Unauthenticated access attempt to endpoint under /v3 path outside of /v3/api-docs
Preconditions: The application service is running and no authentication token or user session is provided
Steps:
1. Send an HTTP GET request to an endpoint under the /v3 path other than api-docs, such as /v3/config. 2. Check the response status and message.

Test Data: URL: /v3/config
Expected Result: The system rejects the unauthenticated request with an HTTP 401 Unauthorized or HTTP 403 Forbidden status instead of permitting access.
